title: data-cap Observation Model
description: Canonical, versioned runtime observations: which field names were seen at which boundaries in which scopes -- names and paths only, never values (see ADR 0070, ADR 0072). Generated from src/flow/observation-model.ts's ObservationModel type -- never hand-authored.

scopes.description: Every distinct scope that contributed at least one observation, sorted.

scopeTimes.description: First/last seen per scope, ordered by scope; absent when no event carried a time.

skipped.description: Events (and skip reports) dropped as malformed -- stated, never silent.

truncations.description: What the recorder reported leaving out, ordered by scope, field, reason; absent when it reported nothing.

truncatedScopes.description: The scopes with a truncation, sorted -- a claim built on one cannot be called verified near the cut. Absent when none.

field.description: Capability-qualified dotted field path -- the Flow Model's field-node naming.

count.description: How many matching events were recorded.

firstSeen.description: Earliest time any matching event carried (ISO 8601, UTC); absent when none carried one. Never used in the id.

lastSeen.description: Latest time any matching event carried; present exactly when `firstSeen` is.

FlowBoundaryKind.description: What a data-flow rule can name as a destination: the declared endpoint kinds, plus the two destinations only code analysis can see.

DataFlowEndpointKind.description: What kind of boundary a declared data-flow endpoint crosses -- a data store (`database`/`cache`/`storage`/`queue`), an external entity (`api`/`external-service`/`user-input`), or something internal to this codebase (`computed`/`internal`).

FlowHandling.description: The declared data-safety state of a value at a boundary crossing -- the vocabulary of `DataFlowEndpoint.handling` and of flow policy rules.

ObservationScopeTimes.description: First and last time anything was observed in one scope; only for scopes whose events carried times.

field.description: Capability-qualified dotted path below which evidence is missing (the capability itself for the root).

count.description: How many times the recorder reported this (scope, field, reason).

ObservationTruncation.description: Evidence the recorder knowingly left out in one scope: below `field` something was not captured. Names only.

ObservationSkipReason.description: Why the walker did not record part of a value.
